curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Facing 3,000 feet of sheer granite without a single protective tether, how does a climber prepare for a feat where even the slightest slip is absolute?
curatedMovie.description: Directors Jimmy Chin and Elizabeth Chai Vasarhelyi capture climber Alex Honnold as he prepares to scale Yosemite's 3,000-foot El Capitan wall entirely alone, attempting the massive vertical ascent without ropes.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: High-stakes, gripping, and deeply suspenseful; a demanding adventure documentary that pairs steady precision with vertigo-inducing tension.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: It translates an unthinkable physical feat into pure cinematic suspense, capturing sheer vertical scale alongside the singular focus demanded by an ascent with zero room for error.
